title: Federal Trucking Record Retention Guide
subtitle: ELD, driver, accident, maintenance, DVIR, and inspection periods
description:
An attorney-edited matrix of selected federal minimum retention periods for commercial-motor-vehicle records, with direct eCFR sources, applicability cautions, and litigation-preservation notes. A regulatory retention period is not a safe waiting period and does not cover every video, telematics, communication, or electronic artifact. Verify current law and case-specific facts. Maintained by Jones Law P.A. / Jones Law Group in Jackson, Mississippi.

GitHub: https://github.com/jacob-601injured/cmv-record-retention-matrix

resources.description: Selected federal retention periods, triggers, scope cautions, preservation notes, official sources, and verification dates.

userSpecifiedSources: Official [Electronic Code of Federal Regulations, Title 49](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-49/subtitle-B/chapter-III/subchapter-B). Each row links to the specific section checked on September 11, 2026.
